title: sci-RNA-seq 3 Level Protocol
author: Beth Martin
materials: Concentration of library and agarose gel purification: Pool 3ul of each well and do a 0.8X ampureXP cleanup (230ul beads). (Save the remaining plate in case you need to redo cleanup or if you anticipate needing more library for a large Novaseq run). Wash the ampure bead pellet twice gently with 70% EtOH (vol/vol) and elute pool in 50ul. Load this into a single 1cm well on a 1% agarose gel (wt/vol). Cut out the smear between 250-600bp and use the NEB gel extraction kit, using extra dissolving buffer since it will be bigger than a normal slice and run it all through the same purification column. Wash twice with 200ul NEB wash buffer, elute in 20ul EB. Quantitate library with Qubit dsDNA HS.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Environment
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and equipment to maintain cold temperatures throughout the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Prepare two ice buckets with wet ice.
Prepare a bucket with crushed dry ice for frozen tissues.
Prepare a thick, flat slab of dry ice for tissue smashing.
Precool a microfuge and a centrifuge (capable of holding 50ml tubes) to 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Determine the required volume of lysis buffer based on tissue type and prepare the complete solution on ice in 50ml tubes.

substeps.instruction: Determine volume: E13.5 mouse embryo (~200mg) = 5ml; E16.5 embryo (~500mg) = 10ml; Adult mouse heart = 5ml; Adult mouse kidneys = 5ml per kidney; Adult mouse liver = 20ml; Adult mouse pancreas = 15ml. (Use higher volumes for adult tissues or those high in RNases).
For every 1ml of lysis buffer, add 2.5μl 10% igepal (vol/vol) and 10μl DEPC to the hypotonic lysis buffer solution.
If using lysis buffer B, add an additional 40μl BSA per 1ml of buffer.
Vortex the solution to disperse DEPC.
Perform subsequent steps in a chemical hood until DEPC is washed from the sample (Step 17).

steps.title: Tissue Pulverization
steps.instruction: Smash frozen tissue into a powder without allowing it to thaw.

substeps.instruction: Fold aluminum foil into a small pouch with 4 layers on each side and chill on a dry ice slab.
Place frozen tissue in the foil pouch, hold firmly on dry ice, and smash with a hammer until powdered.
Use the foil to guide powdered tissue into the 50ml tube of lysis buffer.
Rinse any remaining sample from the foil into the tube using the lysis buffer.

steps.title: Lysis and Filtration
steps.instruction: Lysis the tissue and filter out large debris.

substeps.instruction: Cap the 50ml tube, shake to disperse chunks, and let sit on ice for 10min.
Triturate chunks with a 1ml pipette tip to separate them.
Pour lysate through a 40μm cell strainer placed on top of another 50ml tube on ice.
Use a disposable pestle to coax tissue through the filter.

steps.title: RNase Activity Check
steps.instruction: Verify the absence of RNase activity before proceeding.

substeps.instruction: Take a 45μl sample of filtered lysate and test with the IDT RNaseAlert kit.
If RNase is detected, restart with a new sample and increase lysis buffer/DEPC volume.

steps.title: Nuclei Recovery and Fixation
steps.instruction: Isolate nuclei and fix them using DSP and methanol.

substeps.instruction: Spin the remaining lysate at 500xg for 3min at 4°C.
Resuspend nuclei in 1ml 0.3M SPBSTM containing 10μl DEPC per ml.
Prepare fixative: add 100μl 50mg/ml DSP stock solution to 4ml ice-cold methanol for every 1ml of starting nuclei.
Add fixative gradually to nuclei and swirl to mix.
Rehydrate nuclei by adding 2 volumes of 0.3M SPBSTM gradually (2–3ml at a time), swirling between additions (e.g., 10ml buffer for 1ml nuclei + 4ml fixative).
Spin nuclei at 500xg for 3min at 4°C and remove supernatant.
Resuspend nuclei in 1ml (or more) 0.3M SPBSTM and triturate gently.

steps.title: Storage and Optional Sonication
steps.instruction: Aliquot and store fixed nuclei, or sonicate if clumps persist.

substeps.instruction: Divide nuclei into microfuge tube aliquots, spin at 500xg for 3min at 4°C, remove supernatant, snap freeze in LN2, and store at -80°C (up to 6 months).
Optional: If clumps persist, sonicate (Diagenode Bioruptor Plus) on low intensity for 12s at 4°C, then spin and resuspend in 1ml 0.3M SPBSTM.

steps.title: Nuclei Quantification and Preparation
steps.instruction: Determine the required number of nuclei and prepare them with dNTPs.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend frozen nuclei in 500μl 0.3M SPBSTM and count (dilute if necessary).
If clumpy, pass through a 40μm Flow-mi pipette tip filter before counting.
Pull out desired nuclei and spin; remove supernatant.

Resuspend in the volume and add 10mM dNTPs according to the chart: 
- 12 cols: 2M nuclei, 500μl vol, 56μl dNTPs
- 6 cols: 1M nuclei, 250μl vol, 28μl dNTPs
- 4 cols: 800K nuclei, 170μl vol, 19μl dNTPs
- 3 cols: 500K nuclei, 125μl vol, 14μl dNTPs
- 2 cols: 400K nuclei, 85μl vol, 9.5μl dNTPs
- 1 col: 200K nuclei, 42.5μl vol, 4.75μl dNTPs

steps.title: Reverse Transcription (RT)
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription on the nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 5μl nuclei+dNTP mix to each well of a plate on ice.
Add 2μl of 10μM 3-level RT primers (5′-/5Phos/CAGAGCNNNNNNNN[10bpRTindex]TTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTT-3′) to each well; stir gently with tips.
Incubate at 55°C for 5min (heated lid 65°C), then immediately place on ice.
Prepare RT mix per plate: 240μl 5X Superscript IV buffer, 60μl Superscript IV (200u/ul), and 60μl water (for 12 wells).
Add 3μl of reaction mix to each well (10μl total), stirring gently.
Incubate at 55°C for 10min (heated lid 65°C), then immediately place on ice.

steps.title: Nuclei Recovery after RT
steps.instruction: Recover and wash nuclei following the RT reaction.

substeps.instruction: Ice plates for 10–15min, then add 5μl cold 0.3M SPBSTM per well.
Pool wells using a 12-multichannel with 200μl tips (pipetting up and down to dislodge nuclei), combining rows into the bottom row, then collect into 2 cold microfuge tubes.
Spin at 500xg for 3min at 4°C and remove supernatant.
Wash once more with 1ml cold 0.3M SPBSTM, spin at 500xg for 3min at 4°C, and remove supernatant.
Resuspend nuclei in 1200μl 0.3M SPBSTM.
Distribute 11μl of nuclei to each well of a new plate on ice.
Add 2μl of 10μM 3-level ligation primers (5’- GCTCTG[9bp or 10bp ligation index]TACGACGCTCTTCCGATCT[reverse complement of ligation index]-3′) to each well; do not pipet up and down.
Prepare ligase mix: 195μl 10X T4 ligation buffer + 65μl T4 DNA Ligase (3:1 ratio).
Add 2μl ligase mix to each well (15μl total).
Incubate 20min at room temperature.
Add 10μl cold SPBSTM to each well.

steps.title: Nuclei Recovery after Ligation
steps.instruction: Recover and wash nuclei following ligation.

substeps.instruction: Pool wells using a 12-multichannel (pipetting up and down), combine rows into the bottom row, and collect into 2 cold microfuge tubes.
Spin at 500xg for 3min at 4°C and remove supernatant.
Wash twice more with 1ml 0.3M SPBSTM per wash, spinning at 500xg for 3min at 4°C between washes.
Resuspend in 1ml 0.3M SPBSTM to count. If clumpy, sonicate for 6s or use a flow-mi filter.

steps.title: Second Strand Synthesis Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare nuclei for second strand synthesis.

substeps.instruction: Target 1000 nuclei/well (or 4000/well for 384x384x384 scale).
Prepare 1X Second Strand Synthesis buffer: 40μl 10X buffer in 360μl water (per plate).
Spin down 100K nuclei (or 400K for 384x384x384) per plate and resuspend in 400μl 1X Second Strand Synthesis buffer.
Put 4μl nuclei into each well of a regular (non-lo-bind) plate on ice.
Cover with foil seal and freeze at -80°C or proceed immediately.

steps.title: Second Strand Synthesis and Protease Treatment
steps.instruction: Synthesize the second strand and digest proteins.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction mix per plate: 378μl water, 42μl 10X second strand buffer, and 140μl second strand enzyme (20X).
Add 1μl of second strand synthesis mix to each well (5μl total).
Incubate at 16°C for 2.5 hours (no heated lid).
Add 1μl Qiagen protease (#19157) to each well.
Incubate at 37°C for 30min (47°C heated lid).
Verify digestion: mix 1μl sample with 2μl diluted yo-yo1 dye on a slide; check GFP channel for DNA whisps instead of intact nuclei.
Heat-inactivate protease at 75°C for 20min (85°C heated lid). Place plate on ice immediately after.
Prepare tagmentation mix on ice per plate: 550μl TD buffer and 13.75μl N7-loaded Tn5.
Add 5μl tagmentation mix to each well (~10-11μl total).
Incubate at 55°C for 5min. Keep on bench at room temperature afterward.
Prepare transposase removal buffer per plate: 48μl 1% SDS, 48μl BSA, and 216μl water.
Add 2.6μl of removal buffer to each well and mix.
Incubate at 55°C for 15min.
Quench SDS by adding 2μl 10% Tween 20 (vol/vol) to each well.

steps.title: Library Amplification (PCR)
steps.instruction: Amplify the library using indexed primers.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PCR master mix per plate: 2200μl 2X NEBNext, 22.2μl TruSeq P5-noindex primer (100μM), and 352μl water.
Add 2μl of 10μM indexed P7 primers (5’- CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGAT[PCR P7 index]GTCTCGTGGGCTCGG-3′) to each well.
Add 23.4μl of PCR master mix to each well.
Run 16 cycles with the following program: 17°C 3min $ightarrow$ 98°C 30s $ightarrow$ 98°C 10s $ightarrow$ 63°C 30s $ightarrow$ 72°C 1min (repeat 3-5 15x) $ightarrow$ 72°C 5min.
Check results on a 6% PAGE gel; look for a faint smear centered at 400bp.

steps.title: Sequencing
steps.instruction: Run the library on a NextSeq or NovaSeq sequencer.

substeps.instruction: Use standard primers.
Settings: Read1 34 cycles, Index 10 cycles, Read2 48 cycles.
If P5 primers were used for PCR, add a second Index read of 10bp.
